findings.summary: R1 acceptance test AT1 is not fully satisfied by milestone M1 alone; M1 only delivers ingestion plugin (DL4) but AT1 requires full build completion with output directory creation, which depends on M4 (Emit Plugin C17).

evidence.note: R1 requires recursive discovery of .md files and full build execution.
evidence.quote: The system MUST accept a user-specified local directory path as input and recursively discover Markdown files

evidence.note: AT1 requires CLI build with output directory and build log showing discovered files.
evidence.quote: Run the CLI build with the input directory path and a valid output directory path

evidence.note: M1 delivers ingestion plugin but not full build pipeline or output emission.
evidence.quote: Minimal Ingestion Plugin (C11) that scans a directory and populates C10

evidence.note: Emit Plugin (C17) that writes output is delivered in M4, not M1.
evidence.quote: Emit Plugin (C17) writing pages and static assets to output directory

findings.summary: R2 acceptance test AT2 is mapped to milestones M1 and M2, but AT2 requires serving the complete static site with all pages and assets, which cannot be satisfied until M4 (Theme/Template Plugin C15 and Emit Plugin C17) is complete.

evidence.note: R2 requires complete static output with HTML/CSS/JS that can be served.
evidence.quote: The system MUST generate a static build output consisting only of HTML, CSS, JavaScript

evidence.note: AT2 requires inspecting output directory and serving the site in a browser.
evidence.quote: Serve the output with a simple static file server and open the site in a browser

evidence.note: M2 delivers Markdown rendering plugin but not page assembly or emission.
evidence.quote: Markdown Render Plugin (C14) with CommonMark-compliant parsing and HTML generation

evidence.note: M4 delivers Theme/Template Plugin and Emit Plugin required for complete static site.
evidence.quote: Theme / Template Plugin (C15) rendering per-note pages

findings.summary: R3 acceptance test AT3 is mapped to milestones M1 and M2, but AT3 requires one-to-one HTML page generation for non-excluded Markdown files, which depends on M4 (Theme/Template Plugin C15 and Emit Plugin C17) to produce actual HTML pages in the output directory.

evidence.note: R3 requires generating a corresponding HTML page for every non-excluded Markdown file.
evidence.quote: generate a corresponding HTML page for every input Markdown file not explicitly excluded

evidence.note: AT3 requires counting generated HTML note pages and verifying one-to-one mapping.
evidence.quote: Count generated HTML note pages and verify a one-to-one mapping for non-excluded files

evidence.note: M2 delivers Markdown-to-HTML conversion but not final page generation or emission.
evidence.quote: Markdown Render Plugin (C14) with CommonMark-compliant parsing and HTML generation

evidence.note: M4 delivers Theme/Template Plugin and Emit Plugin required to produce HTML pages in output.
evidence.quote: Theme / Template Plugin (C15) rendering per-note pages
